jackal.line: Nah brother, it's the year of the jackal
jackal.linePrev: Trying to weave a web but all that I believe in is dead

shackle.line: But now I know your heart is shackled
stanza: There was a time when I believed
But now I know your heart is shackled
The more I learn to care for you
Why can't I free your doubtful mind
And melt your cold, cold heart?
